dedupe_keys.name: indonesia power map peta ketenagalistrikan indonesia power plants substations and transmission from ruptl and openstreetmap

description: Indonesia Power Map is an open digital map of the Indonesian power system built from public data for education, exploration and general analysis, started in 2026 and at version 1.1.1 on 24 June 2026. It combines the substation lists and provincial generation aggregates of the RUPTL PLN 2025-2034 electricity supply plan with OpenStreetMap coordinates for plants, substations and transmission lines, validated against PLN statistics and the ESDM energy handbook. Across eight regions it holds 590 power plants, 1,005 RUPTL substations of which 931 are located (about 94 percent match), and 4,053 transmission features, 5,577 features in all, with manual overrides for coordinates and plant names. Processed CSV and GeoJSON files by region and layer, extraction logs and scripts are available free on GitHub and archived on Zenodo; data and documents are CC BY-SA 4.0 and code Apache 2.0, and OSM content stays under ODbL. Coverage is Indonesia, dense for Java, Sumatra and Sulawesi and thinner in Maluku, Papua and Nusa Tenggara. Caveats: the README states that it is a knowledge map, not an operational dataset, match rates are lowest in rural Nusa Tenggara, and electrical parameters are not given. Simulation uses are a national plant, substation and line layer for Indonesian grid, hazard exposure and planning models. Related records: model-pypsa-ph is a comparable island-system model for the Philippines.
